## Unit (required)

## What you need

- [ ] Product path / residual honesty (HARD / SEG / DIRTY labels)
- [ ] Known pack/script readiness
- [ ] Client or engine bug notes
- [ ] Anchors / tiles / combat floor for harness
- [ ] Other: …

One paragraph:

```
need:
```

## Who is asking

- [ ] Human
- [ ] Coding agent (tool)

## Smell-test agreement

I understand shared extracts must:

- Not present as official Lost City
- Label soft thrash honestly (no soft-green authenticity)
- Stay scoped (not a full plans dump)
- Exclude secrets, cache blobs, and private machine paths

Maintainers follow Decision **011** § *On-request context*.
